newsitem.title: USA: Vinini group holds Applied Magnetics stake.
newsitem.headline: Vinini group holds Applied Magnetics stake.

text.p: A group led by former Magellan Fund manager Jeffrey Vinik said Thursday it holds a 6.4 percent stake in Applied Magnetics Corp.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it has acquired 1,493,200 common shares of the company, for which it paid $40.11 million. It said it holds the stake for investment.
It said it bought the stake between November 1 and January 7 at prices ranging from $21.2848 to $32.3921.
Applied Magnetics is a Goleta, Calif.,-based firm that makesmagnetic reecording heads for computer peripheral equipment.
